Your time is the filter

Every lead starts with a session

The first real step is time with you. That's generous, but it means your calendar does the sorting, and every session with someone who isn't ready is an hour you don't get back.

Stages end at the applause

Live rooms have nowhere to go next

When you speak or host an experience, the room hears you once. Without a class to send them to, most of that goodwill leaves with them.

Content treadmill

2,189 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post. When you step back, which is exactly the kind of power you coach people to reclaim, the lead flow steps back too.

Plenty of people who follow you for the reminder to come back to their power aren't ready for 1:1 coaching today. Right now there is nowhere for them to say a small yes.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass called Return to Your Power, with a kit straight after checkout

You already have the credentials, the stage presence and a message people save and share. What's missing is one evergreen 60-minute class that teaches how leaders step back into their own authority, with a little self amusement along the way. A $17 seat filters for people who act, a [$37] kit on the thank-you page adds a second small yes, and the replay invites the right people to apply. Meta ads put the class in front of new leaders every day, and the front-end sales help pay for the ads.

Sound familiar?

You're good at this. So why do you keep making yourself smaller?

  • You lead a team, a business or a room, and you still over-explain, soften your point or wait for permission.
  • You walk out of a big meeting and replay every word on the drive home.
  • You've read the leadership books, done the courses, and know the theory by heart.
  • You want to feel like yourself at work again: clear, grounded and, honestly, having a bit more fun.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Who is this for?

Leaders, founders and professionals who are good at what they do, and still over-explain, soften or shrink to fit. If you want to feel clear and like yourself at work again, it's for you.

Why is it $17?

It's a full 60-minute masterclass with a live Q&A, the Power Leak checklist and a 7-day replay. A small price means everyone in the room has chosen to be there.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, available for 7 days, so you can watch when it suits you.

What should I bring?

One upcoming meeting, conversation or stage where you want to show up as yourself. Meredith walks you through the before-the-room reset live.

What happens after I sign up?

Check your inbox for your confirmation from Meredith. At the end of the class, Meredith explains how working with her works, so you can choose the support that fits where you are.

Is this therapy?

No. It's leadership coaching and education, not therapy or medical advice. Individual results vary.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The drive-home replay"

Hook
"If you replay every meeting on the drive home, the meeting isn't the problem." (to camera, outdoors, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"Capable leaders are brilliant at reviewing themselves. But when the stakes feel high, that review turns into shrinking: softer words, longer explanations, waiting for permission. What brings you back isn't more self-criticism. It's a short reset and a little self amusement." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach exactly how in a 60-minute class called Return to Your Power. It's $17 and there's a replay. Tap Sign up."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before a big room"

Hook
"Before your next big meeting, ask yourself these three questions." (Meredith holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: what do I actually want to say? Two: who am I trying to please by softening it? Three: what would this look like if I let myself enjoy it?" (caption for each question)
CTA
"I walk through the whole before-the-room reset in my masterclass. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Why a Harvard-trained coach talks about fun"

Hook
"I trained at Harvard and Oxford, and the most useful leadership tool I teach is self amusement." (walking, natural light, a smile)
Body
"When you take yourself a little less seriously, you stop performing and start leading. You say the thing. You hold the silence. You stop replaying it later. If you're new here, my class is the best place to start."
CTA
"It's called Return to Your Power, it's 60 minutes, and there's a replay. Tap Sign up."
